description_en: Invokes the DescribeEcGrantRelation operation to query the authorization relationships between VPC-connected instances and Virtual Border Router (VBR) instances in cross-account VBR connection scenarios
description_zh: 调用DescribeEcGrantRelation接口查询跨账号创建VBR上连场景下VPC实例对VBR实例的授权关系
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-ec-grant-relation --instance-type VBR --instance-id vbr-bp12mw1f8k3jgygk90000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeEcGrantRelation

parameters.help_en:
The type of the instance for which you want to query the authorization relationship. Valid values:

VBR: Virtual Border vRouter (VBR) instance used for routing. Queries the VPC-connected instances that have authorized the VBR instance.
VPC: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) instance. Queries the VBR instances that the VPC-connected instance has authorized
parameters.help_zh:
要查询授权关系的实例类型。取值：

VBR：边界路由器VBR（Virtual border router）实例，表示查询VBR实例拥有哪些VPC实例的授权。
VPC：专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）实例，表示查询VPC实例对哪些VBR实例进行了授权
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the instance for which you want to query the authorization relationship.

If InstanceType is set to VBR, set this parameter to the instance ID of the VBR instance.

If InstanceType is set to VPC, set this parameter to the instance ID of the VPC-connected instance
parameters.help_zh:
要查询授权关系的实例ID。

当InstanceType取值为VBR时，此处配置为VBR实例ID。

当InstanceType取值为VPC时，此处配置为VPC实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging in a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值：50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VBR instance for which you want to query the authorization relationship.

If InstanceType is set to VBR, this parameter is required.

If InstanceType is set to VPC, this parameter is not required
parameters.help_zh:
要查询授权关系的VBR实例所在地域ID。

当InstanceType为VBR时，该参数需要配置。

当InstanceType为VPC时，该参数不需要配置
parameters.name: vbr_region_no

EcGrantRelations.description_zh: 查询授权关系的结果列表

items.description_zh: 查询授权关系的结果列表

AliUid.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the VPC instance in the authorization relationship belongs
AliUid.description_zh: 查询的授权关系的VPC所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the VPC-connected instance granted the authorization to the VBR instance
GmtCreate.description_zh: VPC实例对VBR实例的授权时间

GrantType.description_en:
The scope of VBR instances that receive the authorization. Valid values:

All: Grants authorization of the VPC-connected instance to all VBR instances in the specified region and under the specified Alibaba Cloud account.
Specify: Grants authorization of the VPC-connected instance to a specified VBR instance
GrantType.description_zh:
接受授权的VBR实例的范围。取值：

All：将VPC实例授权给指定地域和阿里云账号（主账号）下的所有VBR实例。
Specify：将VPC实例授权给指定VBR实例

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the VPC-connected instance in the authorization relationship
InstanceId.description_zh: 查询的授权关系的VPC实例ID

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the VPC instance in the authorization relationship
InstanceName.description_zh: 查询的授权关系的VPC名称

InstanceRouterId.description_en: The ID of the vRouter of the VPC instance in the authorization relationship
InstanceRouterId.description_zh: 查询的授权关系的VPC路由器ID

RegionNo.description_en: The region ID of the VPC instance in the authorization relationship
RegionNo.description_zh: 查询的授权关系VPC所在地域ID

Status.description_en:
The result of the authorization relationship query. Valid values:

Created: The VPC-connected instance and the VBR instance have an authorization relationship.
Deleted: The VPC-connected instance and the VBR instance do not have an authorization relationship
Status.description_zh:
查询授权关系的结果。取值：

Created：VPC实例与VBR实例已有授权关系。
Deleted：VPC实例与VBR实例没有授权关系

VbrInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the VBR instance in the authorization relationship
VbrInstanceId.description_zh: 查询的授权关系的VBR实例ID

VbrOwnerUid.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the VBR instance belongs
VbrOwnerUid.description_zh: VBR实例所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID

VbrRegionNo.description_en: The region ID of the VBR instance in the authorization relationship
VbrRegionNo.description_zh: 查询的授权关系的VBR实例所在地域ID

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for paging in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数
